high_level_description: The image shows a person taking a mirror selfie in what appears to be a bedroom or dressing room. The individual is wearing an elegant, off-white wedding dress with a sweetheart neckline and thin spaghetti straps. The dress has a full, tulle skirt that flows down to the floor. The person is holding a smartphone with both hands, using it to take the photo. They have short, dark hair and are wearing a bracelet on their left wrist. The background features a large, ornate gold-framed mirror above a bed with white bedding.
